reason: Fixed schema: made contextRef optional (required:false) in Conversations collection. The route fix (conditionally including contextRef only when doc exists) was correct but insufficient — Payload's required-field validation fires on UPDATE operations when the stored document has no contextRef. Making the field optional resolves the 500. Typecheck, lint, unit tests, format all pass. Integration test cannot run locally (MongoDB Atlas timeout) but the fix is logically sound.
